newsitem.title: PARAGUAY: Paraguay June inflation up 0.8 percent.
newsitem.headline: Paraguay June inflation up 0.8 percent.

text.p: Paraguayan prices rose 0.8 percent in June after falling by 0.3 percent in May and rising by 0.3 percent in June 1996, the Central Bank said Tuesday.
Cumulative inflation during 1997 is now 6.0 percent, down from 6.4 percent registered in the same period a year earlier.
Inflation over the past 12 months was 7.9 percent, down from 9.6 percent registered a year ago. ((-- Daniela Desantis, Asuncion Newsroom, 595 21 444527/8))
